artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount Saint Albans
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in opulent early 17th-century attire, standing and facing slightly right. He gazes towards the viewer with a composed expression. The man has a prominent forehead, mustache, goatee, curly ear-length hair, and is holding a paper with his right hand on a table next to a plumed hat. The background features a grand curtain or drapery. The engraving identifies the person as Francis Bacon with Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Viscount Saint Albans
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a three-quarter length portrait. He is positioned slightly to the left and is holding a document or letter with his right hand, while his left hand hangs at his side. The man has a beard, moustache, curly hair, and a calm expression. He is wearing an elaborate period costume with embroidery, lacework, a ruffled collar, and an embroidered cloak or robe. Lace cuffs are visible around his wrist. The background features draped curtains and decorative patterning. The portrait is identified as Francis Bacon.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated position. He has a beard, mustache, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears an intricate outfit with a large ruff collar, ornate sleeves, and the portrait is framed in an oval shape. Below the portrait are decorative elements including a crown, scepter, and a scroll with inscriptions. The background has detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.artist: George Vertue after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a ruffled collar, goatee, long curly hair, high forehead, slight mustache, and beard. He is wearing a decorated garment, likely a robe, with intricate patterns and embellishments. The oval-framed portrait includes a crown, scepter, and a crest or coat of arms. An ornate banner below the portrait identifies the man as "S. Fran: Bacon Kt, Ld: Verulam Viscount St. Alban, Lord Chancellor of England." The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a niche. He is sitting on a throne or chair, with his right hand supporting his head. The man has a beard, mustache, large curly hairstyle, and ornate attire. He wears a decorated jacket, collar, pantaloons, stockings, and decorative shoes. There are Latin inscriptions on the plinth below him, and the background resembles a carved stone structure.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the figure from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. The individual has a prominent nose, full beard, mustache, and wavy, medium-length hair. The person wears formal, detailed clothing with a high lace ruffled collar and a wide-brimmed hat. The background features an ornate oval frame with the inscription "ST. FRANCIS BACON VISCOUNT ST. ALBAN LORD CHANCELLOR." At the top of the page, the text reads "For the London Magazine."

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon, Lord Chancellor
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of Sir Francis Bacon. He is shown from the chest up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. Bacon has a serious expression, with a neatly trimmed mustache and beard. His curly hair is visible under a large, dark, wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in formal attire with a cloak, ruff collar, and no jewelry. The portrait is set within an oval frame, surrounded by the text "BACON T. VERULAM" and at the bottom is "Sr: FRANCIS BACON Ld: CHANCELLOR." The background within the oval frame is shaded with lines, and the outer area is a plain, light-colored rectangle.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon, Lord Chancellor
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait drawing of Sir Francis Bacon. He is depicted from the chest up, facing the viewer directly. Bacon has a bearded face with a mustache, curled hair under a broad-brimmed hat, and wears an elaborate outfit with a wide ruffled collar typical of the period. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame on a textured background. Below the portrait, the text reads "Sr. FRANCIS BACON LP. CHANCELLOR" with a stylized signature.

artworks.title: Bacon
artworks.artist: William Henry Worthington after Paulus van Somer I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in formal attire, standing with one hand on a table holding a piece of paper. He has a beard, mustache, and styled hair. He wears an elaborate coat with embellishments, a ruffled collar, and a sash. He wears a ring on his hand. Behind him is a curtain, and next to him is a table with a tasseled cloth. The background suggests an interior setting with a column on the left side.

artworks.title: Monument of Lord Bacon in Saint Michael's Church
artworks.description: The sculpture is a monument of Lord Bacon, depicted seated with one arm resting on the back of the chair and the other hand supporting his head in a thoughtful pose. The subject wears period attire, including a ruffled collar and a long coat. The sculpture is set within an arched alcove which forms part of the overall structure. The material appears to be stone or a composite resembling stone, with a monochrome engraving. Text below the sculpture on the monument provides further context, listing inscriptions in Latin. The sculpture has a lifelike rendering, capturing the detailed attire and demeanor customary to its era.

artworks.title: Bacon, Baxter, Blackstone, Beattie, Burns
artworks.description: The image features illustrations of five historical figures, each shown from the waist up. At the top left is Lord Bacon, top right is Richard Baxter, in the center is Judge Blackstone, bottom left is Dr. James Beattie, and bottom right is Robert Burns. Each figure is shown in distinct attire and poses. The names of the figures are written near their portraits in elegant script. The background is plain, and the paper shows signs of age and wear.

artworks.title: Hooker, Spenser, Lord Bacon, Ben Johnson
artworks.description: The image features four male figures illustrated from the shoulders up, arranged in two tiers. The figures are labeled "HOOKER," "SPENSER," "LORD BACON," and "BEN JONSON." Each figure is depicted with distinct facial hair, hairstyles, and clothing styles. The background is textured gray with a banner displaying the names above the figures. In the foreground, there is an open book on a decorative stand.

artworks.title: Sir Nicholas Bacon, Lord Keeper
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. The man is facing slightly to the left, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a short, neatly trimmed beard and mustache and is wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a detailed garment with fur trim and is holding a staff in his right hand. The background is plain, with handwritten text above and below the portrait identifying him as "Nicolaus Baconus" and including the words "Mediocria firma."

artworks.title: Sir Nicholas Bacon, Lord Keeper
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This image depicts a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is seated and turned slightly to his right. He has a round face, with prominent eyes and a full beard. His head is covered with a flat, round hat with a wide brim. The man is wearing an elaborate coat with a high fur collar and a buttoned doublet underneath. He is holding a staff in his right hand and wears a bracelet on his right wrist. The background is a plain surface with the phrase "Mediocri Firma" to the left of the man's head. At the bottom, the image includes text with the name "Nicolaus Baconus" and additional Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Sir Nicholas Bacon, Lord Keeper
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved portrait of an older man. He is positioned facing slightly to his left and is holding a small staff in his right hand. He has a round face with a short beard and mustache, and his hair is covered by a large, rounded hat with a flat top and a decorative band. He wears a fur collar over a patterned outfit, and a ruffled collar around his neck. The background consists of a plain parchment-like surface with some text visible around the image.

artworks.title: Marchioness of Baden
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman showing her from the waist upwards. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features include a slightly rounded face, prominent eyes, a small mouth, and an elegantly styled high forehead. Her hair is swept back and styled in an intricate, up-do fashion surrounded by an embellished headpiece. She is wearing a richly ornated gown with an elaborate lace collar that fans out dramatically around her neck. A visible adornment of pearls decorates her bodice, and she is wearing pearl earrings. The background consists of a circular border with Latin inscriptions surrounding the portrait and a patterned texture filling the area around her head. The section below the border contains a block of text.

artworks.title: Elizabeth van Pallandt, Countess of Culemborg, Wife of Jacob, Margrave of Baden
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features are delicately rendered with high cheekbones and a smooth complexion. She has an elaborate hairstyle with her hair pulled back in a high bun adorned with ribbons. The woman is wearing an ornate garment with a large ruffled collar. The attire includes a richly textured dress, possibly with embroidery or patterning. The background is solid with a circular border enclosing the portrait, featuring an inscription around it. Beneath the image, there is additional text.

artworks.title: David Baker
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the side. The man has a prominent forehead, deeply set eyes, and a beard and mustache covering his chin and lip area. His hair is sparse and receding. He is wearing a dark, hooded garment typical of a monastic robe. The background is a textured surface with drapery effects.

artworks.title: Walter Baker, Inventor of a Medicine
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in 18th-century attire seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the left, looking at the viewer. The man has a detailed face with visible eyes, nose, and lips. He has a wig styled in soft curls. The man's clothing includes a dark coat with buttons and a decorative collar. His left arm rests on a surface, possibly holding a pen, directed towards an open book on a table in front of him. The chair has carved details on the left side. The background is heavily shaded, focusing on the man's head and upper body, with the rest of the image plain.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This portrait depicts a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to the left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a long, full beard and mustache, and his hair is mostly covered by a cap. The man is wearing a dark garment with a visible collar. He holds a closed book in the crook of his left arm. The background consists of a simple cross-hatched pattern, with textured shading around the figure highlighting his features.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's portrait showing the upper half of his body. He is posed in a slightly turned stance, looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a well-defined mustache and short, wavy hair framing his face. He is wearing a detailed, patterned gown with a collar and draped with a sash over his left shoulder. In his left hand, he holds a pair of dividers, pointing them at a globe. The background consists of an intricately hatched oval frame with text surrounding it, and additional writing below the oval.

artworks.title: John Bale, Bishop of Ossory
artworks.description: The image shows a man's head and shoulders, facing slightly to the right with a stern expression. He has a high forehead, a long beard and mustache, and wears a fabric cap. The man is dressed in historical clothing, likely a robe or cloak. The background features an oval frame, typical of an engraving, with text surrounding the man's portrait and additional text below the oval.

artworks.title: William Knollys, Earl of Banbury, When Viscount Wallingford
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the torso up. The man is seated and turned slightly to his left. He has a furrowed brow, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a tall, flat-brimmed hat, and his hair is short and curls slightly from underneath his hat. His clothing is detailed, featuring a coat with puffed sleeves, ornate buttons, and embroidery. He wears a large, ruffled collar around his neck. In one hand, he holds a small book or document. The background shows a frame with ribbons and banners containing Latin text, along with a coat of arms at the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Richard Bancroft, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man seated and facing slightly towards the viewer. The man has a calm expression, a full beard and mustache, and is dressed in a clerical outfit with a white ruffled collar, dark robes, and a flat cap. The portrait is encased in an ornate oval frame with decorative elements. Below the portrait is a plaque inscribed in Latin identifying the man as Richardus Bancroft, Archbishop, with a shield and religious symbols. The background has floral patterns in the corners.
